h:e5d6e7d2.patch:
@@ -326,30 +326,30 @@ trap restore_checkout EXIT
 # by anything that moves the remote-tracking ref in between.
 lease_sha=$(git rev-parse "$remote/$branch")
 
-# --prepare leaves its result on refs/heads/<branch>, so the one exception to the
+# --keep-local leaves its result on refs/heads/<branch>, so the one exception to the
 # rule above is checked before anything moves: the branch must be checked out
 # here or nowhere, and hold nothing origin does not.
-if [ "$prepare" -eq 1 ]; then
+if [ "$keep_local" -eq 1 ]; then
   here=$(realpath -e -- "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)")
   held=$(git worktree list --porcelain | awk -v b="branch refs/heads/$branch" \
            '/^worktree /{w=substr($0, 10)} $0 == b {print w}' | head -1)
   [ -z "$held" ] || held=$(realpath -e -- "$held" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$held")
   if [ -n "$held" ] && [ "$held" != "$here" ]; then
     echo "kk-restack: REFUSING: '$branch' is checked out in $held, the ticket's checkout." >&2
-    echo "kk-restack: run kk-restack $ident --prepare from there. Nothing was touched." >&2
+    echo "kk-restack: run kk-restack $ident --keep-local from there. Nothing was touched." >&2
     exit 5
   fi
   local_sha=$(git rev-parse --verify --quiet "refs/heads/$branch" || true)
   if [ -n "$local_sha" ] && [ "$local_sha" != "$lease_sha" ]; then
-    prepared=$(mval restack_prepared)
-    if [ -n "$prepared" ] && printf '%s' "$prepared" | jq -e --arg h "$local_sha" --arg l "$lease_sha" \
+    unpushed=$(mval restack_unpushed)
+    if [ -n "$unpushed" ] && printf '%s' "$unpushed" | jq -e --arg h "$local_sha" --arg l "$lease_sha" \
          '.head == $h and .lease == $l' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
-      echo "already prepared: '$branch' is at $local_sha here; $remote/$branch is still at $lease_sha."
+      echo "already kept locally: '$branch' is at $local_sha here; $remote/$branch is still at $lease_sha."
       echo "next: kk-packet ensure $ident"
       exit 0
     fi
     echo "kk-restack: REFUSING: local '$branch' is at $local_sha, not $remote/$branch ($lease_sha)." >&2
-    echo "kk-restack: it holds commits origin does not, and preparing would replace them. Nothing was touched." >&2
+    echo "kk-restack: it holds commits origin does not, and keeping a restack here would replace them. Nothing was touched." >&2
     exit 5
   fi
 fi

h:ed62163e.patch:
@@ -405,12 +405,12 @@ never rides on a push.
 
 **A reviewed restack becomes a chain-break packet** (PER-144) replays
 PRI-173: a stacked branch approved at A, its parent squash-merged and deleted.
-`kk-restack --prepare` leaves B on the branch in the ticket's checkout, origin
+`kk-restack --keep-local` leaves B on the branch in the ticket's checkout, origin
 untouched; the follow-up packet is `not-descendant` with lease A, and
 `kk-packet ensure` builds it against the default branch, not the stale parent
 ref. Approving it queues one force-push job; Gatekeeper refuses a moved lease
 and a checkout not at B, and `finish` settles `parent_tip_sha`, clears
-`parent_branch` and drops `restack_prepared`. Dirty trees, failed builds,
+`parent_branch` and drops `restack_unpushed`. Dirty trees, failed builds,
 conflicts, dropped commits, another worktree holding the branch and unpushed
 local commits each leave both sides where they were; `--dry-run` is unchanged.
 `kk-grant --sha … force-push` is refused, and `kk-may` names a checkout/head

h:f219a625.diff/header: @@ -137,7 +137,7 @@ if [ -n "$sha" ] && case " $* " in *" force-push "*) true ;; *) false ;; esac; t
h:f219a625.patch:
@@ -137,7 +137,7 @@ if [ -n "$sha" ] && case " $* " in *" force-push "*) true ;; *) false ;; esac; t
   echo "kk-grant: error: force-push is not granted by --sha: it needs the remote head it may replace, its lease." >&2
   echo "kk-grant: approve the chain-break packet for that revision instead, on its page or with" >&2
   echo "kk-grant:   kk-grant $id force-push --packet <packet id> --lease <the remote head it recorded>" >&2
-  echo "kk-grant: a restack of a reviewed ticket gets one from kk-restack <ticket> --prepare, then kk-packet ensure. Nothing recorded." >&2
+  echo "kk-grant: a restack of a reviewed ticket gets one from kk-restack <ticket> --keep-local, then kk-packet ensure. Nothing recorded." >&2
   exit 1
 fi

h:f4f08cb4.patch:
@@ -2647,7 +2647,7 @@ printf '#!/usr/bin/env bash\nprintf "%%s\\n" "$*" >> %q\nexit 6\n' "$pq_sudo_log
 chmod +x "$pq/stub-build"
 go env FAKE_SUDO_HELPER="$pq/stub-build" FAKE_SUDO_LOG="$pq/sudo-calls.log" \
   kk-packet ensure PRI-173 --workspace primarykids --session-key 'agent:main:telegram:direct:1'

h:fdcef720.diff/header: @@ -2701,23 +2701,23 @@ check "  CLEAR at lease A; the push lands B; finish settles the stack: parent_ti
h:fdcef720.patch:
@@ -2701,23 +2701,23 @@ check "  CLEAR at lease A; the push lands B; finish settles the stack: parent_ti
       && [ "$p3" -eq 0 ] && [ "$(pq_git "$PQ_O" rev-parse "refs/heads/$PQ_B")" = "$pq_B" ] && [ "$st" -eq 0 ] \
       && contains "$out" "parent_branch cleared" && [ "$(pks .state)" = completed ] \
       && [ "$(pq_meta parent_tip_sha)" = "$pq_S" ] && [ "$(pq_meta parent_branch)" = "<none>" ] \
-      && [ "$(pq_meta restack_prepared)" = "<none>" ] && echo yes || echo no )" \
+      && [ "$(pq_meta restack_unpushed)" = "<none>" ] && echo yes || echo no )" \
   "$c3/$p3/$st: $o3 / $out / $(pq_meta parent_tip_sha) $(pq_meta parent_branch)"
 
 # --- 4. every failure leaves local and remote where they were
 pq_safe() {   # → yes when nothing moved and nothing was recorded
   [ "$(pq_local)" = "$pq_A" ] && [ "$(pq_on)" = "refs/heads/$PQ_B" ] \
-    && [ "$(pq_git "$PQ_O" rev-parse "refs/heads/$PQ_B")" = "$pq_A" ] && [ "$(pq_meta restack_prepared)" = "<none>" ] \
+    && [ "$(pq_git "$PQ_O" rev-parse "refs/heads/$PQ_B")" = "$pq_A" ] && [ "$(pq_meta restack_unpushed)" = "<none>" ] \
     && [ "$(pq_meta parent_branch)" = "$PQ_P" ] && echo yes || echo no
 }
 pq_reset
 echo dirty > "$PQ_R/c.txt"
-run pq_restack --prepare --verify true; st=$?
+run pq_restack --keep-local --verify true; st=$?
 pq_git "$PQ_R" checkout -q -- c.txt
 check "a dirty worktree: refused (exit 1), nothing moved" \
   "$( [ "$st" -eq 1 ] && contains "$err" "working tree is dirty" && [ "$(pq_safe)" = yes ] && echo yes || echo no )" "exit $st: $err"
 pq_reset
-run pq_restack --prepare --verify false; st=$?
+run pq_restack --keep-local --verify false; st=$?
 check "a rebase that does not build: exit 9, the branch and HEAD back at A, nothing recorded" \
   "$( [ "$st" -eq 9 ] && contains "$out" "VERIFY FAILED" && [ "$(pq_safe)" = yes ] \
       && [ -z "$(pq_git "$PQ_R" status --porcelain)" ] && echo yes || echo no )" "exit $st: $out$err"
